en: The front shows the richly decorated interior of a historic pharmacy with dark carved wooden cabinets filled with apothecary jars, marble-topped counters, a decorative fountain, and ornate wallpaper and chandelier. The reverse side is a classic divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian text giving the location and photo credit, plus a printed price of 20 forints.
